name: pluma-test-analytics
description: Pluma TestPoint Analytics — command center for test_entretien Playwright runs

scripts.dev: npm run build -w shared && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w shared && npm run build -w backend && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run build -w shared && npm run test -w tests
scripts.import:reports: npm run build -w shared && npm run import:reports -w backend --
